title: Tull Road Warrior
author: Sam Thirouin
description: You wake up at the sound of your alarm clock. Brushing the sleep from your eyes, you suddenly realize today is the day Jethro Tull will be playing downtown at your neighborhood theatre. As you jump out of your dear, sweet, dead grandmother's old canopy bed that you inherited along with the house and property, a darker thought comes to mind: You don't even have a ticket yet...
